recipes.title: Create combos / packs / kits from products already in the store (with generated images)
steps: tiendanube_store_get {} -> note "languages" (e.g. ["es"]).
Find the components: tiendanube_products_list {"q":"remera","fields":"id,name,variants,images","per_page":50}. Never browse the admin for this.

OPTIONAL image: make the combo picture with YOUR OWN image tool (e.g. a collage/composition of the component photos on a clean background, square, at least 1000x1000), save it as a local .png/.jpg and keep the absolute path.

tiendanube_create_combo {"name":"Combo Verano","components":[{"product_id":111,"quantity":1},{"product_id":222,"quantity":2}],"discount_percent":10,"image_files":["/absolute/path/combo.png"]}. Add "dry_run":true first only if you want to preview. Components with more than one variant need "variant_id".

The combo is created UNPUBLISHED (draft). Tell the user the name, price and stock, then ask "Do you want me to publish it?". To publish: tiendanube_products_update {"id":<new product id>,"published":true}.
Repeat step 4 for each combo the user asked for (one call per combo).
notes: The Tiendanube API only READS native Kits (GET /kits/{id}); native Kits are created in the admin panel. This tool creates a regular product that represents the combo.

A regular combo product does NOT deduct the components' stock when sold. The tool sets the combo stock to the scarcest component; tell the user to keep it in sync, or to create a native Kit in the admin if they need automatic deduction.

recipes.title: Raise or lower prices on many products
steps: Read the affected variants: tiendanube_products_list {"category_id":456,"fields":"id,name,variants","per_page":200} (add "q" or "published" to narrow; follow next_page).
Compute the new price of every variant yourself and show the user a before/after table with the number of variants. Wait for the user to agree.
Apply: tiendanube_products_batch_stock_price {"items":[{"id":123,"variants":[{"id":789,"price":"16800.00"}]}]}. MAX 50 VARIANTS PER CALL (API limit): split longer lists into several calls.
Keep the old prices in your answer so the change can be undone with the same tool.
notes: Prices are decimal strings. Promotional prices are set per variant with tiendanube_variants_update {"promotional_price":"..."}.

recipes.title: Check or change stock
steps: Low stock list: tiendanube_products_list {"max_stock":5,"fields":"id,name,variants"}.
Find by SKU: tiendanube_products_get_by_sku {"sku":"REM-001-M"} -> note product id and variant id.
Set exact stock: tiendanube_variants_update_stock {"product_id":123,"id":789,"action":"replace","value":40}. Add stock: "action":"variation","value":20.
Many products at once: tiendanube_products_batch_stock_price {"items":[{"id":123,"variants":[{"id":789,"inventory_levels":[{"location_id":"L1","stock":40}]}]}]} (max 50 variants per call).

recipes.title: Create a new product (with variants, images, category)
steps: tiendanube_store_get {} for the languages, then tiendanube_categories_list {} to find (or tiendanube_categories_create {"name":{"es":"Remeras"}}) the category id.

tiendanube_products_create {"name":{"es":"Remera Básica"},"published":false,"categories":[456],"attributes":[{"es":"Talle"}],"variants":[{"values":[{"es":"S"}],"price":"15000.00","stock_management":true,"stock":10,"sku":"REM-001-S"},{"values":[{"es":"M"}],"price":"15000.00","stock_management":true,"stock":10,"sku":"REM-001-M"}],"images":[{"src":"https://example.com/foto.jpg"}]}. No sizes/colors: omit "attributes" and send one variant without "values".
Local image file instead of URL: tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file {"product_id":<new id>,"file_path":"/absolute/path/foto.png"}.
Tell the user it was created as a draft and ask before publishing (tiendanube_products_update {"id":<id>,"published":true}).

recipes.title: Add or replace product images (including images you generated)
steps: Local file (generated or downloaded): tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file {"product_id":123,"file_path":"/absolute/path/foto.png","position":1,"alt":{"es":"Remera roja"}}.
Public URL: tiendanube_product_images_create {"product_id":123,"src":"https://example.com/foto.jpg"}.
Reorder / alt text: tiendanube_product_images_update {"product_id":123,"id":<image id>,"position":1}. Remove: tiendanube_product_images_delete.
notes: jpg, png, gif or webp; under 10 MB (the documented general limit); max 250 images per product.

recipes.title: Audit the catalog (missing images, SKU, weight, hidden or out-of-stock products)
steps: Hidden products: tiendanube_products_list {"published":false,"fields":"id,name"}.
Without SKU or weight: tiendanube_products_list {"has_skus":false,"fields":"id,name"} and {"has_weight":false,"fields":"id,name"}.
Low stock: tiendanube_products_list {"max_stock":5,"fields":"id,name,variants"}.
Without images or description: tiendanube_products_list {"fields":"id,name,images,description","per_page":200} and check the empty ones yourself.
Fix what the user approves with tiendanube_products_update / tiendanube_variants_update / tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file.

recipes.title: Improve titles, descriptions and SEO fields
steps: Read: tiendanube_products_list {"fields":"id,name,description,seo_title,seo_description","per_page":50}.

Write per product: tiendanube_products_update {"id":123,"seo_title":{"es":"..."},"seo_description":{"es":"..."},"description":{"es":"

...

"}}.

recipes.title: Orders that are paid but not shipped
steps: tiendanube_orders_list {"financial_status":"paid","shipping_status":"unpacked","per_page":50}.
Order detail: tiendanube_orders_get {"id":1042}.

recipes.title: Mark an order as dispatched with tracking
steps: tiendanube_fulfillment_orders_list {"order_id":1042} -> note the fulfillment order id.
tiendanube_fulfillment_orders_update {"order_id":1042,"id":"<fulfillment id>","status":"DISPATCHED","tracking_info":{"code":"ABC123"},"notify_customer":true}.

recipes.title: Sales summary for a period
steps: tiendanube_orders_list {"created_at_min":"2026-10-01T00:00:00-03:00","created_at_max":"2026-10-31T23:59:59-03:00","financial_status":"paid","per_page":200,"fields":"id,number,total,created_at,products"}; follow "next_page" until has_more is false.
Compute orders, revenue, average ticket and top products yourself from the items.
notes: Orders are capped at page*per_page <= 10000: slice long periods by date ranges.

recipes.title: Create a discount coupon
steps: tiendanube_coupons_create {"code":"BIENVENIDA15","type":"percentage","value":"15","max_uses_per_client":1,"end_date":"2026-12-31"}. Types: percentage | absolute | shipping.

recipes.title: Recover abandoned carts
steps: tiendanube_abandoned_checkouts_list {"created_at_min":"2026-10-30T00:00:00-03:00"}.
Create a coupon (recipe "coupon"), then tiendanube_abandoned_checkouts_apply_coupon {"id":<checkout id>,"coupon_id":<coupon id>} for each checkout.

recipes.title: Fix connection problems (401, 403 missing scope, wrong token, new permissions)
steps: Call tiendanube_doctor {}. It reports the connection and any known missing permissions without disclosing the credentials.
401 → Run tiendanube-mcp login for a Partner app, or tiendanube-mcp configure for a token supplied by the store. The seller enters the secret in the terminal.

403 → Enable all permissions offered for the app in Tiendanube or Nuvemshop, then reinstall or reauthorize the app so the new token has those grants. Some endpoints require a provider-specific app or store plan.
After authorization, confirm the store using tiendanube_doctor and tiendanube_store_get.
notes: Installation guide: guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md. Enter credentials privately in the local terminal.

# Tiendanube MCP: start here

This server exposes 198 tools. Check authorization with tiendanube_doctor. USE THEM. Do not open a browser or the admin panel for store tasks.

## If the user asks for... -> call...
- Store info, languages, currency: tiendanube_store_get
- Search / list / read products: tiendanube_products_list, tiendanube_products_get, tiendanube_products_get_by_sku
- Create or edit a product: tiendanube_products_create, tiendanube_products_update
- Change price of one variant: tiendanube_variants_update
- Change prices of MANY products: recipe bulk-price (tiendanube_products_batch_stock_price, max 50 variants per call)
- Set / add stock: tiendanube_variants_update_stock, tiendanube_products_batch_stock_price
- Create combos / packs from existing products: tiendanube_create_combo
- Upload an image file you generated: tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file
- Add an image from a URL: tiendanube_product_images_create
- Audit the catalog: recipe catalog-audit (tiendanube_products_list with filters)
- Categories: tiendanube_categories_list, tiendanube_categories_create, tiendanube_categories_update
- Orders: list, read, cancel, close: tiendanube_orders_list, tiendanube_orders_get, tiendanube_orders_cancel, tiendanube_orders_close
- Ship an order / tracking: tiendanube_fulfillment_orders_list, tiendanube_fulfillment_orders_update
- Customers: tiendanube_customers_list, tiendanube_customers_get, tiendanube_customers_create
- Coupons and promotions: tiendanube_coupons_create, tiendanube_coupons_list, tiendanube_promotions_create
- Abandoned carts: tiendanube_abandoned_checkouts_list, tiendanube_abandoned_checkouts_apply_coupon
- Pages and blog: tiendanube_pages_create, tiendanube_pages_update, tiendanube_blogs_list
- Webhooks: tiendanube_webhooks_create, tiendanube_webhooks_list
- Anything else in the Tiendanube API: tiendanube_find_tool, then tiendanube_api_request
- Something fails (401/403/setup): tiendanube_doctor

## Golden rules
1. Tools first. A browser is never needed for store tasks.
2. Text fields are language objects: {"es": "..."}. Price, SKU, weight and stock live on variants.
3. Generate images with your own image tool, save a local file, upload it with tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file.
4. New products and combos are created as drafts (published:false). Ask the user before publishing.
5. Before deleting or changing many records, say what you will do and how many, then do it once the user agrees.
6. When a call fails, read the "Next step:" at the end of the error and do it. For setup/permission problems call tiendanube_doctor.

## Step-by-step recipes (call tiendanube_get_recipe with the id)
- combo: Create combos / packs / kits from products already in the store (with generated images)
- bulk-price: Raise or lower prices on many products
- stock: Check or change stock
- create-product: Create a new product (with variants, images, category)
- images: Add or replace product images (including images you generated)
- catalog-audit: Audit the catalog (missing images, SKU, weight, hidden or out-of-stock products)
- seo: Improve titles, descriptions and SEO fields
- orders-to-ship: Orders that are paid but not shipped
- ship-order: Mark an order as dispatched with tracking
- sales-report: Sales summary for a period
- coupon: Create a discount coupon
- abandoned-carts: Recover abandoned carts
- fix-access: Fix connection problems (401, 403 missing scope, wrong token, new permissions)

Unsure which tool? tiendanube_find_tool {"query":"what you want to do"} (Spanish or English).
instructions:
TIENDANUBE MCP: USE THESE TOOLS. Use this local MCP to access the authorized Tiendanube or Nuvemshop store. Call tiendanube_doctor to check its connection and permissions. Feature availability depends on the store, app and plan.

RULES (follow them exactly):
1. For ANY task about the user's store (products, variants, prices, stock, images, categories, orders, customers, coupons, promotions, shipping, pages, webhooks, reports) call THIS server's tools. Use the browser for user-led installation and authorization.
2. Not sure which tool? Call tiendanube_start_here (task -> tool map) or tiendanube_find_tool with a plain-language query (Spanish or English). For multi-step jobs call tiendanube_get_recipe.
3. Prefer the one-call workflow tools: tiendanube_create_combo (combos/packs) and tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file (upload an image file).
4. No dedicated tool for what you need? Use tiendanube_api_request (any store API route). Only if that also fails, ask the user.
5. Images: create or edit the image yourself with your own image tool, save it to a local file, then upload it with tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file (or pass a public URL as "src"). Never paste base64 into the chat.
6. Text fields (name, description, handle, seo_*) are objects per language: {"es": "..."}. Call tiendanube_store_get once to learn the store's languages.
7. Price, SKU, weight and stock live on VARIANTS, not on the product.
8. Errors end with "Next step:". Do that step yourself. For 401/403 or anything that looks like a setup problem call tiendanube_doctor and follow it. Keep the user's credentials out of chat and tool arguments. Guide them through the terminal installer and the browser consent screen.
9. Before deleting, cancelling or changing MANY records, tell the user what will happen and how many records are affected, then proceed once they agree.
10. Answer the user in the user's language.

resources.tiendanube://docs/scopes-and-limits:
# Tiendanube API: scopes and limits

## Base URLs
- Hispanoamérica: https://api.tiendanube.com/{version}/{store_id}
- Brasil (Nuvemshop): https://api.nuvemshop.com.br/{version}/{store_id}
- Versions: `2025-03` (stable), `v1` (classic alias), `unstable` (External Invoice, Custom Objects, Custom Field Definitions, Store Media, Disputes, aggregates=price_tables)

## Authentication
Classic endpoints read `Authentication: bearer <token>`; modern microservices (Scripts, Pages, Email Templates, Billing, Disputes, External Invoice, Business Rules) read `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. This server sends both, plus a mandatory `User-Agent: AppName (contact@domain.com)`.

## Scopes (18 families)
| Family | Read | Write | Resources |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Store (implicit) | any token | n/a | Store, Webhooks, GET /scripts |
| Content | read_content | write_content | Pages, Blog, Page metafields |
| Products | read_products | write_products | Product, Variant, Image, Category, Kit, Price Tables, product/category custom fields & metafields, Store Media, Custom Objects/Definitions |
| Customers | read_customers | write_customers | Customer, customer metafields/custom fields |
| Orders | read_orders | write_orders | Order, Cart, Abandoned Checkout, order custom fields, External Invoice |
| Fulfillment orders | read_fulfillment_orders | write_fulfillment_orders | Fulfillment Order + tracking events |
| Draft orders | read_draft_orders | write_draft_orders | Draft Order |
| Locations | read_locations | write_locations | Location, inventory levels, location business rules |
| Shipping | read_shipping | write_shipping | Shipping Carrier, options, legacy fulfillments, shipping business rules |
| Shipping quotation | read_shipping_quotation | write_shipping_quotation | Live rate quotation |
| Coupons | read_coupons | write_coupons | Coupons |
| Discounts | read_discounts | write_discounts | Promotions, discount callbacks |
| Payments | read_payments | write_payments | Payment Provider, Transaction, Disputes |
| Payment options | read_payment_options | n/a | Payment Option, payments business rules |
| Scripts | n/a | write_scripts | POST/PUT/DELETE /scripts |
| Email templates | read_email_templates | write_email_templates | Email Templates |
| App subscriptions | read_subscriptions | write_subscriptions | Billing subscriptions |
| Charges & plans | n/a | write_charges, write_plans | Billing charges / plans |

A 403 means the token lacks the scope: tool descriptions list the scope each one needs.

## Rate limit (leaky bucket)
40 requests burst, drains 2 req/s per store+app (10x on Evolución/Next plans). Headers: x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-remaining, x-rate-limit-reset (ms). This server pauses when remaining <= 2 and retries 429s. PUT/PATCH on product variants use a weighted bucket (cost grows with variants, languages and inventory_levels).

## Pagination and filters
page (default 1), per_page (default 30, max 200; max 50 for External Invoice), fields, since_id, created_at_min/max, updated_at_min/max. Orders: page * per_page <= 10000. Empty list/out-of-range page answers 404 "Last page is N" (handled as an empty result).

## Data model rules
- i18n text fields (name, description, handle, seo_title, seo_description, subject, template_html) are objects keyed by language: {"es": "...", "pt": "..."}.
- Price, promotional_price, SKU, weight, dimensions and stock live on Product Variant. Infinite stock = stock null (stock_management false). Multi-location stores use inventory_levels [{location_id, stock}].
- Order line IDs (products[].id) exceed int32: always treat as strings/int64.
- Fulfillment: prefer Fulfillment Orders over the deprecated order-level shipping fields.
resources.tiendanube://docs/checkout-sdk:
# Checkout and Checkout SDK

Tiendanube lets apps integrate with the checkout in two ways:

1. **Callbacks** (server side): shipping carriers (`tiendanube_shipping_carriers_create` with callback_url), payment providers (`tiendanube_payment_providers_create` with checkout_payment_options/checkout_js_url), discount callbacks (`tiendanube_discounts_callbacks_upsert`) and business rules (`tiendanube_business_rules_upsert`).
2. **Checkout SDK** (browser JavaScript): injected through a Script (`tiendanube_scripts_create` with a script created in the Partner Portal) it reads and manipulates the state of the checkout and syncs with payment and shipping options. Used for Transparent Checkout and Nube Pago integrations.

Reference documentation:
- https://tiendanube.dev/api/resources/2025-03/checkout
- https://tiendanube.dev/api/resources/2025-03/checkout-sdk

custom.description: CALL THIS FIRST. Map of tasks to tools, golden rules and recipes for this store.

custom.name: tiendanube_find_tool
custom.description: Describe what you want to do in plain language (Spanish or English) and get the matching tools and recipes.

custom.name: tiendanube_get_recipe
custom.description: Step-by-step recipe (exact tool names and arguments) for a common job such as combos, price changes or stock.

custom.name: tiendanube_doctor
custom.description: Diagnose credentials, connection and missing permissions, with the exact next steps to fix them.

custom.name: tiendanube_api_request
custom.description: Call any Tiendanube API route that has no dedicated tool (last resort before asking the user).

custom.name: tiendanube_create_combo
custom.description: Create a combo/pack product from products already in the store, with price, stock and images (generated files supported).

custom.name: tiendanube_product_image_add_from_file
custom.description: Upload an image file from this computer (e.g. one you generated) to a product.
